prompt: How many years had passed since the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania was admitted to the Union by the time Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born?
answer: Rep. Robert D. Heaton was born in 1873, while Pennsylvania joined the Union in 1787. Thus, **about 86 years had passed**—more precisely, **85 years and roughly 6½ months**.
